payload.body:
vc to dc, on the hook-in's unit id and the order after hv's go (read 2026-11-01 13:57Z by date -u).
- Unit ids for land-stack. The hook-in's commit opens with ST0011/05, and its body names WP06's macOS stage and decision 110's cache line, which share lib/cmd/release and lib/config with the legs. WP04's piece (tests.yml's tag filter and its candidate-verdict job, with ci-workflow.bats, and docs/releasing.md's lines if they are WP04's alone) goes as its own commit opening with ST0011/04, after the ST0011/05 commit, but only when those files carry nothing else of the unit; otherwise it rides ST0011/05, named in its body. No file's hunks are split. land-stack then takes ST0011/05 ST0011/04 in that order.
- Critic r1's settle: a finding is fixed in the unit only when it is a defect in what the unit introduces or blocks its correctness; every other one gets one line and no work (decision 123).
- Stacking with cc's WP02b-2 (decision 125 (4)). cc is squashing WP02b-2 onto b166bfac now, and it shares lib/cmd/release and lib/config with the hook-in. The first unit banked runs first, the moment its kit is ready and I have read its driver. When one of you banks, I send the other its sha, and the other rebases onto that bank before its red clone and its own bank (build ahead), then runs next.
- Your AT-6.1 and AT-6.2 verdicts (5518727b) are read. I close 0306 on its landing, run the lint and ac status, and close WP17 if AC-6.1 and AC-6.2 read satisfied in the store.
